name: Spectral Guardian (Kael Dawnshield)
damage_resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

special_abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
special_abilities.desc: The guardian can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain.

special_abilities.name: Bound Duty
special_abilities.desc: The guardian is bound to protect the Vault. It cannot leave the Vault chambers. It will parley if addressed by name (Kael Dawnshield) — DC 15 Persuasion to convince it to stand down.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the guardian has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken.

reactions.name: Warning Strike
reactions.desc: When a creature attempts to take the stone tablet from Chamber 2, the guardian can make one Life Drain attack against that creature.
